data.narrative:
Beyond Aero is a Series A transportation company founded by Eloa Guillotin, Hugo Tarl\u00e9, and Valentin Chomel, having raised $44M to date. The transportation sector peer set comprises 6 private companies including Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, FleetZero, and REGENT Craft, with no public comparables available.

The Stage-Progression method is applicable and yields a $88M valuation. This approach applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $44M total raised as a proxy for current valuation, reflecting typical Series A advancement dynamics. The Peer-Median method is not applicable: while 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, none satisfy the narrow filtering criteria (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier), and applying an all-sector median would introduce material bias.

The triangulated valuation range is $75M (low) to $101M (high), with a median of $88M. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity bounds around the single applicable method. Key uncertainties include the sparsity of same-stage comparable data in the frontier transportation space, which limits precision and confidence in the stage-progression multiplier assumption. Any valuation within this range should be stress-tested against company-specific burn rates, product milestone timing, and capital efficiency relative to identified peers.
